15 Years in the Workshop

Metal gives no second chances. You measure right, or you cut scrap.

Inderjit Singh founded Lotey Metalcrafts in Ludhiana with a simple, unyielding rule: never skimp on metal gauge, never rush a weld seam, and never deliver a gate that sags after three seasons.

"Custom-built. On-site measured. Welded to last. That’s not marketing talk — that’s the iron oath we make to every client in Punjab and the hills." — Inderjit Singh, Founder & Master Craftsman

Over fifteen continuous years, the workshop has grown from a humble single-station forge near GNE College into a premier architectural metal fabrication studio. Operating alongside his son Rajdeep Singh, Lotey Metalcrafts fuses traditional Punjabi ironsmithing precision with modern fiber CNC laser cutting, structural engineering calculations, and high-end brass and hardwood detailing.

The Evolution

The Fifteen-Year Journey

From forging neighborhood security grills to engineering multi-tier structural staircases and luxury villas across northern India.

2009

The First Spark in Baba Deep Singh Nagar

Inderjit Singh establishes Lotey Metalcrafts near Gill Road, Ludhiana. Armed with an oil-cooled welding transformer, an industrial anvil, and a reputation for honesty, he focuses on heavy wrought iron gates and unbreakable security grills for local residences.

2014

Stainless Steel & High-End Balustrades

As modern architecture swept Punjab, Lotey expanded into SS 304 and 316 argon-TIG welding. Introducing seamless mirror-finish handrails and glass balustrades that solved the perennial rattling issues seen in commercial complexes.

2019

Expansion into Himachal Pradesh & Resorts

Recognizing the demand for weather-resilient architectural metalwork that withstands snowfall and damp mountain conditions, Lotey Metalcrafts began fabricating weather-shielded pergolas, stairways, and balconies for boutique hotels and luxury estates in Shimla, Dharamshala, Solan, and Kangra.

2023

CAD, Fiber Laser CNC & Teakwood Fusion

Rajdeep Singh joins operations, introducing computer-aided 3D drafting and high-precision fiber laser profile cutting. The workshop pioneers hybrid steel-and-teak furniture, suspended metal library shelves, and architectural facade screens.

Present

850+ Projects & Lifetime Client Trust

Today, Lotey Metalcrafts stands as one of the most respected custom metal studios in Punjab, maintaining the same hands-on commitment: Inderjit Singh still personally inspects every critical weld and oversees on-site alignments.

Regional Reach

Serving Punjab & Himachal Pradesh

While our central production workshop is located in Baba Deep Singh Nagar, Ludhiana, our on-site measurement and installation teams operate across:

Punjab

Himachal Pradesh

*Open to large bespoke architectural projects and commercial installations in neighboring states upon consultation.
